summary: Backend-only testing of the NEW binary monthly-qualification + one-time Owner-Club (300%) feature. Rewrote /app/backend/tests/test_tree_engine_api.py for the new 51-node binary seed (old assertions targeted the retired 8-node DEMO_A seed) and added 4 new tests (owner-club permanence, 15-level cascade bound, equal monthly-pool split, interior-leg binary stats). Full suite: 105/105 passed (24 tree tests + iterations 10/11/12 regression). VERIFIED: (1) POST /reward/tree/seed-demo -> seeded=51, root_address=0x..01, 51 DEMO_* docs persisted, ROOT owner_tier=false at seed, L0/R0 binary_parent=ROOT with side left/right, first 5 of each leg sponsored by ROOT, remaining sponsored by their binary parent, all 50 leg nodes $250/active. (2) After build, ROOT breakdown: active_directs=10, qualified_directs=10, direct_business_usd=2500, binary.left_ids=25, right_ids=25, left_business=6250, right_business=6250, monthly_qualified=true, rank=Gold, level_income=465 (L1=10x$250x7% + L2=12x3% + L3=24x3% + L4=4x2%), level_lapsed=0, monthly_pool_usd>0, cumulative_reducing<=mining_cap. (3) One-time Owner-Club: build#1 snapshot shows owner_tier=false/cap=2000 (200% of $1000) and persists owner_tier=true in db.users; build#2 shows owner_tier=true/cap=3000 (300%) and self_roi=600; a standard user (DEMO_L20, $250) stays at cap=500. (4) Permanence: deactivating DEMO_L24 drops left_ids to 24 -> monthly_qualified=false and monthly_pool_usd=0, but owner_tier stays true and cap stays 3000; restoring re-qualifies. (5) Non-qualifying leaf DEMO_L20: monthly_qualified=false, monthly_pool_usd=0, binary 0/0, level_income=0. Interior node DEMO_L0 sees only its own subtree (24 IDs / $6000) -> not qualified. (6) Determinism: two consecutive builds on unchanged data return the identical root and leaf_count (note: build#1 after a seed legitimately differs from build#2 because it grants owner_tier). (7) All 114 proofs from build verify against the root via OZ sorted-pair hashing over keccak256(keccak256(abi.encode(address,uint256,bool))); tampered amount fails; /reward/tree/user proofs verify against the snapshot root; /reward/merkle/latest matches the newest build. (8) Level income bounded at exactly 15 levels: unit test on a 21-node sponsor chain shows uplines at distance 1..15 receive LEVEL_BPS[d-1] (income+lapsed) and distances 16..20 receive exactly 0. (9) Monthly pool splits EQUALLY: synthetic 2-achiever network with monthly=$1000 gives each achiever exactly $500 and everyone else $0. Malformed addresses now return 404 (previous 500 ValueError in logs is stale). No new product defects found.

minor.issue: _require_admin() is a no-op because ADMIN_API_KEY is unset in this environment - a wrong X-Admin-Key still returns 200. Both endpoints WRITE (seed wipes/creates 51 users; build inserts a merkle_roots doc, replaces reward_snapshots, wipes+rewrites reward_proofs, and permanently flips owner_tier). Set ADMIN_API_KEY before deploy or the owner_tier grant is publicly triggerable.

leg_stats() runs a fresh DFS per user for both legs, so binary stats are O(N x subtree) (O(N^2) on a deep chain). At 195 users it is fine; memoize bottom-up (post-order) before this scales to thousands.

monthly_share is computed as pool/achievers and then clamped by min(level_income + m_share, cap). With the live monthly pool ($321k) ROOT's share is truncated to the $3000 cap and the excess is silently discarded - not carried forward or redistributed to other achievers. Confirm this is intended.
Still inserts a new db.merkle_roots doc on every call even when the root is unchanged (no dedupe/TTL); the collection grows unbounded from repeated builds/tests.

user_count has grown 150 -> 195 across iterations from throwaway SIWE test wallets created by other test modules that are not cleaned up. Not a product bug but it dilutes pool-per-user math in this preview DB.

action_items: Set ADMIN_API_KEY (or a dev-only flag) so /reward/tree/build and /reward/tree/seed-demo cannot be triggered anonymously - build permanently grants owner_tier.
Memoize binary leg_stats bottom-up in tree_engine.compute before the network grows (current O(N^2)).
Decide/document what happens to the monthly-pool share that exceeds a qualified achiever's mining cap (currently silently dropped).
server.py is 708 lines (over the 700 guideline) - split the reward/tree routes into their own router module.
critical_code_review_comments: server.reward_tree_build(): owner_tier is granted from the SAME snapshot that was computed with owner_tier=false, so the build that qualifies a user reports the 200% cap and only the NEXT build reflects 300%. Users will see their cap jump one cycle late - consider recomputing (or applying the grant before compute) so the qualifying snapshot already carries the 300% cap.

tree_engine.leg_stats() has no visited-set; a binary cycle (A.binary_parent=B, B.binary_parent=A) would double-count IDs/business up to 15 levels instead of being rejected. Validate binary_parent at placement time.

self_roi = days_since(activated_at) * cap * 0.5% is still recomputed off the CURRENT cap, so the one-time Owner-Club grant retroactively inflates ALL past ROI days (ROOT jumps from $400 to $600 for the same 40 days). Snapshot accrual per day or keep a cap-change history.

The non-reducing bucket (self_roi + daily + weekly pool shares) is still completely uncapped while the reducing bucket is capped - confirm intent, since live pool seeds make per-user pool shares enormous.

monthly_qualified correctly ignores reward_engine.monthly_owner_qualified() (which additionally demands Diamond rank); the two qualification definitions now disagree - delete or align the unused helper to avoid future drift.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/reward/tree/seed-demo (51 DEMO_* users, 0x..01 ROOT + DEMO_L0-24 / DEMO_R0-24). 4 ephemeral SIWE wallets created for referral tests and deleted in module teardown. DEMO_L24 was temporarily deactivated for the owner-club permanence test and restored (with a rebuild) in a finally block.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression file /app/backend/tests/test_tree_engine_api.py now targets the 51-node BINARY seed; ROOT_ADDR is 0x00..01 (the old 0xde00.. addresses and DEMO_A/DEMO_A3 nodes no longer exist). Keep every test in the single class - pytest.ini uses -n 2 --dist loadscope and the tests share DB state; test ORDER matters because owner_tier is a one-time flag (test_03 asserts the pre-grant 200% cap, test_04 the post-grant 300%). Re-seed before asserting owner_tier=false. Do NOT assert absolute user_count deltas: other xdist workers create wallets concurrently (this caused the only failure of this run, fixed with >=). Monthly/daily/weekly pool USD comes from live db.protocol_stats and is large/non-deterministic - assert only >0 / ==0. Equal-split and 15-level-bound behaviours are covered by pure tree_engine.compute unit tests (test_15, test_22) which need no DB.
rca_of_the_issue: No product defect reproduced. Two test-harness issues fixed: (1) the whole tree test file still asserted the retired 8-node DEMO_A seed (seeded==8, level_income==56, direct_business==800) and would have failed wholesale against the new 51-node binary seed - rewritten for the new topology; (2) test_20 asserted an exact user_count delta, which raced with wallets created by the other xdist worker - relaxed to >=. Stale backend.err.log entries (NameError: Header, ValueError on '0xdem...' address) predate the current code: Header is imported at server.py:1 and malformed addresses now return 404.
